title: The Relay Race
subtitle: 考点：团队合作 / relay, baton, catch up with
passage: On sports day, Class 9 had a 4 x 100 metre relay race. Four runners ran one after another, and each one passed the baton to the next runner. The handoff is the most dangerous part. If the baton falls, the team may lose the race.

Danny ran the first part and gave his team a good start. The second runner, Lily, fell a little behind, and the other teams took the lead. Then Jack, the third runner, ran very fast and began to catch up with the leaders. At the last handoff, he passed the baton smoothly to Kevin. Kevin ran with all his strength and crossed the line second. The team did not win, but they all cheered and hugged each other. 'We did our best together,' said Kevin. 'That is more important than a gold medal.'
vocab: relay 接力赛 · baton 接力棒 · handoff 交接 · runner 跑步者 · smooth 顺利的 · strength 力量
